item.title: Ver.5.33
item.description: The firmware update Ver.5.33 from Ver.5.30/Ver.5.31 incorporates the following issues:The following firmware bugs are fixed.(1) Horizontal lines appear on the LCD monitor under the following settings.[Settings]•DRIVE MODE: “CH HIGH SPEED BURST”•SHUTTER TYPE: “MECHANICAL+ELECTRONIC” and shooting with the electronic shutter•SHUTTER SPEED: 1/8000 or faster•IMAGE DISP: “CONTINUOUS”(2) The recorded images may occasionally appear abnormal when shooting in “ISO BKT” or “FILM SIMULATION BKT” mode.(3) The camera may occasionally freeze one minute after playback begins when playing back movies recorded in “Movie” mode (at 6.2K or higher).(4) The focus cannot be adjusted when using the XF30mmF2.8 R LM WR Macro lens and attempting to adjust the focus manually under the following settings.[Settings]•[BUTTON/DIAL SETTING] ➔ [LENS ZOOM/FOCUS SETTING] ➔ [FOCUS RING OPERATION] ➔ [LINEAR] and set any rotation angle except defaultSome other minor bugs are fixed.
